name: settings-panel
title: Settings Panel
description: The two-pane settings dialog every AI chat app converges on, in the mold of Claude's and ChatGPT's own: a live sidebar search, a grouped sliding-highlight tab list, and an Accent color picker that actually retints every focus ring, button, and toggle in the dialog the instant you pick a new one, not just its own swatch. Every field genuinely autosaves (switch tabs or close and reopen the dialog and nothing resets) with a real 'Saving… / Saved' indicator, not a decorative one. A dismissible MFA banner morphs into a real confirmation on click, and the Profile pane's avatar recolors on click too.
